Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la Afya ya Jamii (SHA) linathibitisha tahadhari ya kuzuka kwa homa ya dengue kwa Kaunti ya Nandi. Wakazi wanashauriwa kuepuka kuwasiliana na vyanzo vya maji vilivyochafuliwa.

English: Notice: a free medical camp organised by SHA (Social Health Authority) will be held in Bungoma County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: kambi ya matibabu ya bure iliyoandaliwa na SHA (Huduma ya Afya ya Jamii) itafanyika katika Kaunti ya Bungoma Aprili hii.

English: Office of the Auditor-General urges residents of Uasin Gishu County to engage through the county's online participation portal to shape development planning forums.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mhariri Mkuu inawasihi wakazi wa Wilaya ya Uasin Gishu kushiriki kupitia portal ya ushiriki wa mtandaoni ya wilaya ili kuunda vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.

English: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service urges coffee growers in Marsabit County to practice crop rotation to restore soil fertility to improve yields this season.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Ukaguzi wa Afya ya Mimea ya Kenya inawahimiza wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit kufanya mazoezi ya kugeuza mazao ili kurejesha uzazi wa udongo ili kuboresha mavuno ya msimu huu.

English: Public health advisory: Kenya Medical Association warns of increased Rift Valley Fever risk in Kitui County and advises the public to report any suspected cases to community health volunteers.
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa afya ya umma: Chama cha Matibabu cha Kenya kinaonya juu ya kuongezeka kwa hatari ya homa ya Rift Valley katika Kaunti ya Kitui na inashauri umma kuripoti visa vyovyote vinavyoshukiwa kwa wajitoleaji wa afya wa jamii.

English: Communications Authority of Kenya urges motorists and pedestrians in Embu County to heed evacuation orders issued by local administrators to prevent drought-related incidents.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inawasihi waendesha magari na watembea kwa miguu katika Kaunti ya Embu kutii maagizo ya uhamisho yaliyotolewa na wasimamizi wa eneo hilo ili kuzuia matukio yanayohusiana na ukame.

English: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) reminds livestock keepers in Mandera County to report sick animals to the nearest veterinary office to protect herd health.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inawakumbusha wakulima wa mifugo katika Kaunti ya Mandera kuripoti wanyama wagonjwa kwa ofisi ya veterinari karibu ili kulinda afya ya kundi.

English: HELB encourages out-of-school children in Elgeyo-Marakwet County to apply for the bursary before the deadline under free primary education.
Kiswahili: HELB inawatia moyo watoto nje ya shule katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet kuomba bursary kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya elimu ya msingi ya bure.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds expectant mothers in Uasin Gishu County that access to free antenatal care is free of charge at all public facilities.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha akina mama wajawazito katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu kwamba huduma za bure za uzazi ni za bure katika vituo vyote vya umma.

English: Judiciary of Kenya invites residents of Kisii County to engage through the county's online participation portal regarding public policy consultations.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Kenya inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kisii kushiriki kupitia portal ya kushiriki mtandaoni ya kaunti kuhusu mashauriano ya sera za umma.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) urges residents of Tana River County to seek immediate testing at the nearest health facility following a rise in reported HIV/AIDS cases.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya ya Jamii (SHA) linawahimiza wakazi wa Wilaya ya Tana River wapate upimaji wa haraka katika kituo cha afya cha karibu baada ya ongezeko la visa vya UKIMWI/UKIMWI vilivyoripotiwa.

English: EACC reminds residents of Nyandarua County that attend the county assembly public session strengthens local governance.
Kiswahili: EACC inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua wanaohudhuria mkutano wa umma wa mkutano wa kaunti kuimarisha utawala wa mitaa.

English: Notice: SHA launches the county integrated development plan in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shirika la SHA linazindua mpango wa maendeleo ya wilaya katika wilaya ya Nakuru.

English: E-Citizen announces improved turnaround times for passport services in Elgeyo-Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: E-Citizen inatangaza nyakati bora za kurejesha huduma za pasipoti katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo-Marakwet.

English: Notice: KICD opens applications for revision guides for learners in Isiolo County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: KICD inafungua maombi ya miongozo ya marekebisho kwa wanafunzi katika Wilaya ya Isiolo.

English: Kenya Red Cross reminds residents of Mombasa County that reporting theft promptly helps keep neighbourhoods safe.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya unawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Mombasa kwamba kuripoti wizi mara moja husaidia kuweka majirani salama.

English: KUCCPS reminds parents in Samburu County that bursary allocation registration is open this March.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Samburu kwamba usajili wa utoaji wa ruzuku umefunguliwa Machi hii.

English: IPOA urges the community in Makueni County to avoid sharing personal security details with strangers to curb cattle rustling.
Kiswahili: IPOA inahimiza jumuiya katika Kaunti ya Makueni kuepuka kushiriki maelezo ya usalama wa kibinafsi na wageni ili kuzuia wizi wa ng'ombe.

English: Notice: IPOA activates an emergency response plan for drought in Mandera County.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: IPOA inaamsha mpango wa majibu ya dharura kwa ukame katika Kaunti ya Mandera.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties encourages first-time voters in Kajiado County to verify their details via SMS to 70000.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kajiado County kuthibitisha maelezo yao kupitia SMS kwa 70000.

English: Directorate of Criminal Investigations reminds residents of Turkana County to observe speed limits and use designated pedestrian crossings during this road accidents season.
Kiswahili: Kurugenzi ya Utafiti wa Jinai inawakumbusha wakazi wa Kaunti ya Turkana kuzingatia mipaka ya kasi na kutumia njia za kutembea zilizoainishwa wakati wa msimu huu wa ajali za barabarani.

English: KEPHIS warns sweet potatoes farmers in Siaya County of pest outbreaks and recommends timely intervention.
Kiswahili: KEPHIS inawaonya wakulima wa viazi katika Kaunti ya Siaya kuhusu maambukizi ya wadudu na kupendekeza hatua za wakati unaofaa.

English: Public notice: SHA (Social Health Authority) will host a free food safety outreach in Kericho County this April.
Kiswahili: Taarifa ya umma: Shirika la Afya ya Jamii (SHA) litaandaa kampeni ya bure ya usalama wa chakula katika Kaunti ya Kericho Aprili hii.

English: TSC reminds youth in Vihiga County that HELB funding is available for motor vehicle mechanics training.
Kiswahili: TSC inawakumbusha vijana katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kwamba fedha za HELB zinapatikana kwa mafunzo ya mitambo ya magari.

English: OGP invites residents of Nakuru County to submit written memoranda before the deadline regarding development planning forums.
Kiswahili: OGP inawaalika wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nakuru kuwasilisha maandishi ya maandishi kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho kuhusiana na vikao vya mipango ya maendeleo.

English: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development invites farmers in Narok County to a free training on post-harvest handling this January.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Wanyama inawaalika wakulima katika Kaunti ya Narok kwa mafunzo ya bure juu ya utunzaji wa baada ya mavuno Januari hii.

English: KMTC reminds parents in Makueni County that bursary allocation registration is open this October.
Kiswahili: KMTC inawakumbusha wazazi katika Kaunti ya Makueni kwamba usajili wa utoaji wa ruzuku umefunguliwa Oktoba hii.

English: SHA (Social Health Authority) encourages residents of Nyandarua County not to suffer in silence and to attend a free community counselling session.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya ya Jamii (SHA) linawatia moyo wakazi wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua wasiteseke kwa utulivu na kuhudhuria kikao cha ushauri wa jamii bila malipo.

English: Office of the Registrar of Political Parties encourages first-time voters in Vihiga County to visit the nearest IEBC registration centre.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Mwandishi wa Vyama vya Siasa inawatia moyo wapiga kura kwa mara ya kwanza katika Kaunti ya Vihiga kutembelea kituo cha kusajili cha IEBC kilicho karibu.
